name: Togetherall
one_liner: Togetherall is an anonymous online peer community for mental health, moderated 24/7 by clinicians, available only through a sponsor.
best_for: Students and staff whose university or college offers Togetherall
Employees whose employer or EAP includes it
People who want anonymous peer support at any hour with clinicians watching for risk
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
US adults without a sponsoring school, employer or organisation (there is no way to pay for it yourself)
People who need one-to-one therapy or medication
short_description: Anonymous mental health peer community with 24/7 clinical moderation. Free through universities, employers and health services; no individual plan.
long_description: Togetherall (formerly Big White Wall) is an online peer support community for people 16 and over. Members are anonymous and share and respond to posts, with trained clinicians called Wall Guides moderating around the clock and stepping in if someone is at risk. It also offers self-guided courses and tools. Togetherall says there is no paid individual subscription: you get access free through a funding organisation such as a university or college, employer, health authority (including NHS areas in the UK) or professional body. In the US that mostly means colleges and some employers, so many people can't join on their own. One randomized trial of Big White Wall in England (2021) found no difference from an NHS information website, but only 17% of participants completed the main follow-up, so the result was inconclusive.

pricing.starting_price: Free through a sponsoring university, employer or health service; no individual plan
pricing.notes: Togetherall says there is currently no option for an individual paid subscription. Eligibility routes include post-secondary email, employer or organisation search, and in some areas post/zip code.

privacy.notes: Members are anonymous to each other. Policy excerpts read do not say whether data is sold or used for ads; site cookies are also used for marketing. Data kept 8 years after account closure; deletion on request to theteam@togetherall.com, reviewed by the clinical team.

seo.meta_description: Togetherall is an online peer support community for mental health, offering anonymous support, self-guided courses, and 24/7 clinical moderation.

faqs.a: Togetherall is free for users when their employer, college, or health plan provides it as a benefit. It's not available for direct individual purchase. Check if your organization offers Togetherall access.

Yes, Togetherall is designed for anonymous participation. You create a username not connected to your real identity. The community format allows honest sharing without personal exposure. Clinical moderators ensure safety.

Wall Guides are trained professionals who monitor the community 24/7 to ensure conversations remain supportive and safe. They intervene when someone might be at risk and guide discussions constructively. It's not a replacement for therapy but adds safety to peer support.

faqs.q: How is Togetherall different from Reddit or forums?
faqs.a: Togetherall is purpose-built for mental health with clinical oversight. Unlike general forums, trained moderators ensure safety, conversations are therapeutic, and evidence-based resources are integrated. It's a structured, safe environment rather than open internet discussion.

citation.title: A Direct-to-Public Peer Support Program (Big White Wall) Versus Web-Based Information to Aid the Self-management of Depression and Anxiety: Results and Challenges of an Automated Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: No difference between groups on well-being, depression or anxiety, but only 131 of 790 (16.6%) completed the primary outcome, so the trial could not test effectiveness. A correction was published in 2021.

primary_uses: Anonymous peer support for anxiety, depression and stress
Talking with others at any hour, with clinicians moderating
Student and workplace mental health support

patient_summary: You join under a username and post or read in an anonymous community where trained clinicians (Wall Guides) watch over conversations 24/7, with self-guided courses and tools. You can't pay for it yourself: access is free only if your university, employer, health service or other organisation pays for it. Check eligibility on Togetherall's join page with your school email, employer or zip/postcode.

availability.note: Only through a sponsor (universities, employers, health services such as NHS areas, some professional bodies); ages 16+. No individual paid plan, so many US adults cannot join.
